name: my-app-monorepo
description: My App Monorepo - Next.js 16, Express, Shared Types

scripts.setup: pnpm install && cp -n backend/.env.example backend/.env 2>/dev/null; echo '✓ 依赖安装完成，backend/.env 已就绪'
scripts.dev:all: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:frontend"
scripts.check: pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r lint && pnpm -r format:check
scripts.clean:all: pnpm clean && pnpm -r exec rimraf node_modules && rimraf node_modules
